send_generate.text: I step into the lantern-maker's shop and look at the broken lock on the back door.
I ask who was the last person to see the shop locked last night.
I kneel to look at the scuff marks on the floor near the empty shelves.
I follow the marks out into the alley behind the shop.
I ask the people in the alley whether they heard anything in the night.
I head to the river docks to see whether anyone is selling lanterns cheap this morning.
I talk to the boatman who is loading crates at the dock.
I ask the boatman where the crates came from.
I go back to tell the lantern-maker what we found.
I suggest we wait near the market stalls and watch who comes to sell.
I watch the stalls as the morning market opens.
I step forward and ask the seller where he got his lanterns.
